verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State documents a print-and-mail fallback for Annual Reports through the Annual Report Wizard, and publishes a forms page for filings such as registered agent changes, so a paper rail exists for at least some tasks. The pack never shows the actual mailing address, fax number, or a complete set of paper forms covering formation and other filings. Missing for 10: published mailing address, fax number or fax-filing option, explicit paper forms for formation and amendments, and confirmation that the paper rail covers tasks when the online flow is down.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: Use the Annual Report Wizard to file Annual Reports electronically or to print and mail in your report.
